desc:
🃏 Truco, the famous South American card game, now on Roblox! Play ARGENTINE 🇦🇷, URUGUAYAN 🇺🇾 or PAULISTA 🇧🇷 truco with friends or bots.

👥 Private rooms, 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 with signals for your partner.
🤖 Bots on easy, normal or hard.
🏆 Ranked with 8 tiers, from Mirón to Leyenda.
🎨 60+ decks to collect, plus card backs, tables and effects.
📖 New to truco? The tutorial teaches you in 1 minute.

¡Envido, truco, quiero retruco! 🔥
